# Neşe Alkaya — Content and AI discovery guide

Website: https://nesealkaya.com
Primary language: Turkish (tr-TR)
Additional fully localized language: German (de-DE)
Owner of the personal brand: Neşe Alkaya

## About / Hakkında
Neşe Alkaya offers individual life-coaching conversations and separate spiritual guidance rooted in traditions she describes as Alevi. Discussions aim to support reflection, not make clinical diagnoses or guarantee outcomes.

## Important distinctions
Coaching / Yaşam koçluğu is not a substitute for psychotherapy, medical care, legal or financial advice. Spiritual interpretations are traditional or symbolic interpretations, not evidence-based diagnosis, healthcare or reliable predictions. Pricing, appointment availability and service details must be requested directly rather than inferred.
